name: ns_proofsearch_square_law_exhaust_bridge
rubric_version_reason: Successor after Phase 5DU compressed the finite projection ladder to an exact square law but left the dynamic NSE bridge open.
description: Focused theorem-search substrate for bridging the finite projection square law to a cycle-margin, Littlewood-Paley, smooth-blowup, or no-go theorem.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative frontier theorem-search over the square-law-to-dynamics bridge.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by noncircular observables, dynamic realization, and theorem boundary sharpness.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: Qualitative theorem-search substrate; do not route as numerical fit primitive.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The finite projection ladder around the canonical NS packet has compressed to R_B^2 = 1 - 3/(4B^3 + 12B^2 + 14B + 3), but this is not a Clay proof because sup_B R_B = 1. Reward only a noncircular bridge to cycle-margin exhaust, Littlewood-Paley critical control, smooth-data blowup realization, or a sharp no-go/reranking theorem. Penalize finite-to-infinite supremum induction, phase-fitting, weak convex-integration overclaims, stochastic derandomization handwaves, metric-kernel pressure substitution, cycle variables defined from observed gain/loss, and unbounded dense computation used as a theorem substitute.

dimensions.name: Square-Law Use Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the submission use the exact square law correctly without treating finite subcriticality as an infinite-dimensional bound?

dimensions.name: Cycle-Margin Bridge
dimensions.description: Does it define and use T_section, B(E), k(E), P(E), w(E), v(E), and L(E) independently enough to test Q(E)>=1 or its failure?

dimensions.name: Littlewood-Paley Or Critical-Space Control
dimensions.description: Does it offer a serious dyadic/paraproduct localization of the square-law tax with summable remainders?

dimensions.name: Dynamic Realization Or Smooth Blowup Discipline
dimensions.description: Does any positive/blowup route start from smooth-data NSE and pay residual-defect transfer rather than invoking weak nonuniqueness?

dimensions.name: Anti-Tautology Independence
dimensions.description: HARD GATE. Reject definitions of phases, amplitudes, cycle variables, or defect margins chosen by the desired conclusion.

dimensions.name: Supremum-Trap Avoidance
dimensions.description: Does it explicitly handle the fact that R_B<1 for every finite B but sup_B R_B=1?

dimensions.name: Full-Convolution And Pressure Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it include exterior stretching terms, full nonlinear convolution, Leray projection, and Euclidean pressure treatment?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a theorem packet, exact falsifier, CAS/Lean-facing object list, or decisive proof-cost reranking?

dimensions.name: Adversarial Falsifier Quality
dimensions.description: Does it name the cheapest deterministic or symbolic RAM-safe test that would kill the bridge?

dimensions.name: Scope Honesty And Nonclaim Control
dimensions.description: Does it avoid Clay-level overclaims unless the exact prize-class obligations are paid, and avoid dangerous unbounded compute proposals?

criteria.Square_Law_Use_Discipline: Full credit requires correct use of R_B^2 = 1 - 3/(4B^3 + 12B^2 + 14B + 3) and explicit recognition that it is a finite projection law.
criteria.Cycle_Margin_Bridge: Full credit requires independently defined cycle observables and a concrete inequality linking square-law tax to Q(E) or its failure.
criteria.Littlewood_Paley_Or_Critical_Space_Contr: Full credit requires dyadic localization with high-low/high-high paraproduct burdens stated explicitly.
criteria.Dynamic_Realization_Or_Smooth_Blowup_Dis: Full credit requires smooth-data NSE realization and residual-defect transfer for any constructive blowup route.
criteria.Anti_Tautology_Independence: Score zero for backward-solving phases, amplitudes, cycle widths, dwell times, or loss variables from the target conclusion.
criteria.Supremum_Trap_Avoidance: Reject finite-dimensional induction unless a uniform/summable infinite-dimensional estimate is proved.
criteria.Full_Convolution_And_Pressure_Discipline: Full credit requires full convolution, exterior stretching, Leray projection, and Euclidean pressure treatment.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a usable theorem/falsifier packet or decisive route reranking.
criteria.Adversarial_Falsifier_Quality: Full credit requires the cheapest precise RAM-safe test that would kill the proposed bridge.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Nonclaim_Control: Reject unsupported regularity/blowup claims, weak-solution overclaims, stochastic-to-deterministic handwaves, and unbounded compute proposals.

success_criteria: A noncircular cycle-margin theorem or falsifier involving Q(E), square-law tax, dwell/resupply, and return-time burden.
A Littlewood-Paley localization theorem or falsifier showing whether the square-law tax survives critical-space paraproduct leakage.
A smooth-data blowup construction packet with residual-defect transfer obligations, not weak-solution nonuniqueness.
A no-go/reranking theorem showing the finite projection square law cannot bridge to Clay-level dynamics without an additional missing estimate.
failure_modes: Inferring regularity from R_B<1 for every finite B while sup_B R_B=1.
Choosing phases or amplitudes by solving backward for residual cancellation.
Defining T_section, B(E), P(E), w(E), v(E), or L(E) from the observed G/L margin.
Treating convex-integration weak nonuniqueness as a Clay blowup construction.
Using stochastic regularization as deterministic proof without derandomization.
Substituting a metric kernel for the Euclidean pressure Hessian.
Ignoring full nonlinear convolution or exterior stretching terms.
Replacing theorem-facing discrimination with large dense Fourier jobs, unbounded Lean builds, or the crashed exponential metric transport obstruction.
